title: Integral of the Radon–Nikodym derivative equals one
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and suppose that $\mu$ is absolutely continuous with respect to $
u$, written $\mu \ll 
u$. Then the Radon–Nikodym derivative $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}$ integrates to one against $
u$:
\[
  \int_{\Omega}  rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x)\,d
u(x) = 1.
\]
